errors.text_span: and the slices appear arranged roughly from the largest segment (Moive) through smaller segments around the ring
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are arranged by size, but this is incorrect. The clockwise order of slices is Moive (41.2%), Common (14.9%), Person (30.5%), Book (9.1%), and Sport (4.3%). This is not a descending order of size, as Person (30.5%) is larger than Common (14.9%) but appears after it.
